categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, design, and sales of chips for smart grid terminal devices, primarily focusing on energy metering chips, smart meter MCU chips, and power line carrier communication chips. It also develops battery management system (BMS) chips targeting industrial and automotive applications. The business model follows a fabless approach, outsourcing manufacturing and packaging/testing while focusing on chip design and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-precision Sigma-Delta ADCs, high-precision voltage references, terminal temperature measurement, and energy metering algorithms for energy metering chips; high-precision RTC, embedded PLL, and low-power design for MCU chips; and advanced modulation/demodulation algorithms (BPSK, OFDM, HPLC, G3-PLC) and dual-mode power line carrier and wireless communication for communication chips. The company uses a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to specialized manufacturers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are smart grid terminal equipment manufacturers, including smart meter producers serving the State Grid Corporation of China, Southern Power Grid, and overseas markets. The company’s chips are widely used in smart meters, data collectors, concentrators, and other smart grid devices. Overseas markets include Southeast Asia, Eastern Europe, and Africa, supported by domestic smart meter enterprises expanding globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily in China, serving national and regional power grids, with growing exports to overseas markets such as Southeast Asia, Eastern Europe, and Africa. The company’s manufacturing partners are located in China, including wafer foundries and packaging/testing firms.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless integrated circuit design enterprise. It focuses on chip design and development, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to foundries and subcontractors, and sells finished chips to downstream smart meter manufacturers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment to enhance core chip technologies in energy metering, MCU, and power line communication. The company is advancing next-generation high-precision metering chips, high-performance MCUs with CAN Bus, and dual-mode communication chips integrating power line and wireless. It is also expanding into BMS chips for new energy and industrial applications. The company emphasizes patent development, talent acquisition, and building advanced R&D centers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuit chips for smart grid terminal devices. The company sells chips mainly via a buyout distribution model and direct sales to select customers. It also earns income from licensing intellectual property and technology services related to chip solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in the smart meter chip market, holding the top market share in three-phase metering chips in China and ranking highly in single-phase SoC chips in export markets. It competes with international and domestic semiconductor firms but leverages local market knowledge and customization capabilities as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 603 million, a 15% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 131 million, down 34%. Despite revenue decline due to market conditions and reduced tender volumes, the company maintains a strong asset base with total assets around RMB 2.16 billion and net assets of RMB 2.04 billion. R&D investment increased by nearly 15%, accounting for over 25% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile focused on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, reliability, and low power consumption in its chip products, supported by proprietary core technologies and extensive patent portfolios. Its multi-product line covering metering, MCU, and communication chips offers comprehensive solutions for smart grid terminals. The fabless model allows focus on innovation and cost control, while stable supply chain partnerships ensure product quality and delivery. The company’s local market insight and customization capabilities provide differentiated value to domestic and international customers.
